node.title: Re^3: Granular padding peaks in graphs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I'm using gnuplot. It has an offset parameter.. but leaves me with the same problem. PS: I like Ploty.js too! But I tend to make heavy use of fenceplots

I see... well perhaps the plot could be emulated with Plotly's 3D Mesh plot. But an [id://1177642|SSCCE] with Gnuplot would still be helpful to have as a basis for something to play around with.
